anti_triviality_controls.axis_name_preference: REJECTED_AS_PREMISE; violates declared cyclic symmetric subcase and is unnecessary in minimal control
anti_triviality_controls.ceiling_only: Q,p=2..6 produces a complete cyclic/injective radius4 atlas; survival is evidence of nonuniqueness, not a derivation of ceiling
anti_triviality_controls.first_round_homogeneous_additive: REJECTED_AS_POSITIVE_MODEL; history-dependent on A2 and trivializes ray to p1 by premise
anti_triviality_controls.floor_only: Q,p=2..6 produces a complete cyclic/injective radius4 atlas; survival is evidence of nonuniqueness, not a derivation of floor
anti_triviality_controls.midpoint: Q,p=2..6 produces a complete cyclic/injective radius4 atlas; therefore midpoint is not forced
anti_triviality_controls.nearest: Q,p=2..6 produces a complete cyclic/injective radius4 atlas; therefore nearest is not forced
anti_triviality_controls.old_zero_sum_raw_coordinate: REJECTED_BY_HARD_FIRST_STEP_CONTROL because 1-1-1=-1, not a fixed zero-sum sheet
anti_triviality_controls.parity_alternation: For Q,p=2 it survives radius4; for p=3..6 it causes distinct-cell collisions, e.g. C[-4,3], C[-4,4], C[-3,4] can collapse to (-1,-1,4). In no case is parity promoted.
anti_triviality_controls.path_sum_first_step_increments: REJECTED; same-cell paths -w and +u,+v disagree under the path-sum H control
